text:
And trembling love slipped

along the mute shores of your absence.

Night became the body of your essence,

and the open field folded, defeated.


A yesterday of your lips in my ear,

a sonorous footprint, a cadence,

made your presence a flower of heartbeats

at the final edge of forgetting.


You came upon an air of poppies.

Like sighs bursting red,

beneath the ardor of the full stars,


the lips advanced like waves.

And submissive in the dream of your eyes,

pain died in the flowering veins.

translation.title: Memory
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps memory as sound, flower, red sigh, and pain dying in the beloved's gaze.
